_comment: What `validate` holds THIS project to. Project policy, read by scripts/validate_tree.py;
a project without this file has its git-tracked arms checked, no floors,
no scorer sources and only the bundled demo's duplicate exception.
committed       the arms reports cite, each named by its label's prefix (runs, pair,
repeats, linux, silver, adjudicated, judged-judge-summ-v1, ...): V7 (every
run has its first score), V8 (no duplicate system on a dataset) and V9
floors          V9: each arm (a label's prefix) must keep at least this many scores, so
deleting evidence fails; raising one is a deliberate edit
scorer_sources  V10: the scores of one arm (arms: its label's prefix; glob: which of its
runs, by run id) that claim the current scorer, and the code that says what
the current scorer is. module is a .py path relative to this project's
root; callable returns a hash or a dict of named hashes
duplicate_ok    V8: (dataset_id, system) pairs allowed to repeat, each one justified
systems         V18: globs, relative to this project's root, of systems kept outside
data/systems (the examples'), so their model_record notes are seen
